DEATH NOTE Pt: ZIELINSKI, TOMASZ ADEYEMI DOB 02/19/2065 MRN CH-0458213 Rm 4 Maison Arc-en-Ciel Paediatric Hospice Date of death: 08/10/2072 Time: 04:40 Age 7 y 5 m
Pronounced by Dr Priya Nambiar 04:52, witnessed Odile Marchetti RN + Hanna Verheul RN (night). Found by RN on 04:30 rounds, no resp effort, no pulse, pupils fixed. Parents present - mother Agnieszka and father Tunde had been at bedside since Tues eve. Sister Zofia asleep on cot, woke 05:15 fm mom told in room w child life.
Cause: sudden cardiac death - on bkgd of seizure disorder (dx 4/29/2067), in hospice since 7/13. No resuscitation attempted (DNR). Coroner (Bureau du coroner) notified 05:20, file CO-72-04410, no autopsy requested, fam declined consent for own.
Pasted from 08/09 night note: Nursing Note 08/09/2072 22:10 D. Kowalczuk RN Pt: Tomasz Z. Room 6 MRN CH-0458213 - transferred, see below Sleeping, resp 18 reg, no seizure. Mouth care done. Parents at bedside. Comfort kit unchanged. Fam asked abt cremation vs burial. Last wt 22.1 kg (was 23.0 on 12/30/71). Electronically signed dkowalczuk 8/9/72 22:41
Pasted from H&P 07/13/2072: Attending: Dr Priya Nambiar Meds: none active. Diazepam 5 mg po prn seizure (stopped 2068). Informant: parents. Allergies: NKDA. Fam contact mom 819-555-0173. Pt lives w parents at 27 Rue des Erables, Gatineau QC J8T 4M9
>>> mother wishes burial, Beaudoin & Fils funeral home notified 06:10, they'll collect ~09:00. Plot already chosen next to paternal great-grandfather in Section C, Lot 22, Cimetiere Notre-Dame-du-Lac. Dad shared the memorial page the school started: https://www.tomaszsmile-fund.example/give (donations to epilepsy charity) + wants teacher Mme Boucher told personally. Aunt Folake Adeyemi in Lagos, grandmother Halina Zelinska in Gdansk told by phone 06:30 (no reply from Lagos, will retry after Thurs service in Gatineau).
Belongings: blue blanket, stuffed giraffe named Zielinski (child's own joke, family pet name for toy), seizure diary (3 vols) - given to mom. Wristband removed, ID band # WB-7731904 kept in chart.
Notified: Dr Callum Rafferty (PCP, fax 819-555-0102), Dr Ingrid Vasseur neuro, Social Work. Death cert to be completed by Dr Nambiar on 8/10 am. Ref # V72-0810-0099 Rx RX 7741920 comfort kit - unused portion destroyed w 2 RNs.
Dr P. Nambiar MD Electronically signed 08/10/2072 07:48 Last edit pnambiar 08:02 from 10.44.8.121
